request.purpose: What the device sends to request a financial or specialized operation

response.purpose: What the host/authorizer returns for the request

lifecycle.purpose: How related requests and responses form a transaction flow

boundaryRules.rule: Do not validate response-only Element 83/26/7 fields as Segment 100 request fields.
Do not treat a response code as a valid request Prompt Code transaction type.
Do not certify lifecycle correlation from one isolated message or metadata-only claims.
Do not infer companion-segment requirements from transaction type alone.
Do not certify EMV, eWIC, token, wallet, Moneris, TransArmor, or Premium Gift Card behavior using generic Segment 100 fixtures.

artifactMapping.lifecycleJson: ordered message collection with original/follow-up roles
artifactMapping.brTsTcTd: Each domain-specific rule retains its source anchor across all artifact levels
